title: Canonical derived projection map for condensed module objects
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], $f:X\to Y$ a scheme morphism, and $\Lambda_T=p_T^*\Lambda$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. Use the ordinary unbounded module-object derived functors $Lf^*\dashv Rf_*$ [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull] and relative K-flat derived tensors [sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom]. Write $d_{M,N}:Lf^*(M\otimes^{\mathbf L}N)\to Lf^*M\otimes^{\mathbf L}Lf^*N$ for the canonical tensor comparison induced by ordinary module pullback and localization: it is the derived bifunctor lift characterized by the two derived counits and the signed total of the ordinary scalar-extension tensorator. Define the canonical projection map
$$\pi_{f,K,L}:Rf_*K\otimes^{\mathbf L}L\longrightarrow Rf_*(K\otimes^{\mathbf L}Lf^*L)$$
to be the adjoint transpose of $d_{Rf_*K,L}$ followed by $\varepsilon_K\otimes1$, where $\varepsilon$ is the counit of the specified derived adjunction.
